name: Research planning and roadmap
premocir_instantiation: cohort definition -> feature engineering -> model selection -> interpretability -> web app -> manuscript
note: Clinical-ML pipeline maps cleanly onto phased plan

name: Research question management
premocir_instantiation: RQ: can ML + explainability predict cardiac-surgery mortality better than standard risk scores; sub-Q on SHAP interpretability
note: One primary RQ + a methods sub-question

name: Task management
premocir_instantiation: data cleaning, imbalance handling, model tuning, SHAP analysis, app build, figure prep

name: Documentation
premocir_instantiation: cohort inclusion/exclusion, feature list, preprocessing, model config, evaluation protocol
note: High value: clinical studies require a frozen protocol; the template already forces it

name: Decision traceability
premocir_instantiation: model choice (XGBoost), class-imbalance strategy, decision threshold, ethics/data-governance approvals
note: Exactly the choices a clinical-ML paper must justify to reviewers; the convention captures them

name: Collaboration and contribution tracking
premocir_instantiation: multi-author: ML lead + clinical co-authors + informatics supervisors
template_mechanism: branches + PRs + CODEOWNERS (e.g. clinical/ vs analysis/)
note: Designed for it; not exercised retrospectively

name: Communication
premocir_instantiation: clinical-vs-technical alignment on outcome definition and feature validity

name: Version control
premocir_instantiation: 3 notebooks (data analysis, ML, interpretability), model configs, app code
template_mechanism: Git; strip notebook outputs; tag at submission
note: Notebooks version fine with output stripping

name: Research artifact management and integration
premocir_instantiation: notebooks + trained model + SHAP figures in-repo; patient dataset held outside
note: Restricted patient data cannot be in the repo; linked by reference (DUA-gated)

name: Research provenance and artifact linkage
premocir_instantiation: RQ -> cohort (external) -> notebook -> model -> SHAP figure -> paper figure -> Zenodo release
note: Chain reconstructable once linkage discipline is followed

name: Transparency
premocir_instantiation: code and notebooks public (Zenodo 18249069, CC-BY); patient data embargoed
note: Process and code transparent; data disclosure blocked by patient-privacy law - the caveat the framework already states

name: Reproducibility support
premocir_instantiation: notebook environment + pinned versions reproducible; full reproduction needs data-use agreement
note: Code-side reproducible; data-side needs an approved DUA - external

name: Automation
premocir_instantiation: notebook-execution / output-freshness checks; light CI typical for clinical projects
note: Available; clinical projects often use it lightly

name: Research output management and identification
premocir_instantiation: Zenodo deposit of the 3 notebooks with DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18249069 (CC-BY); MDPI paper
note: PreMoCir already did this shape; maps 1:1 to the template's release/archive components

name: Governance and sustainability
premocir_instantiation: IRB/ethics approval, data-use agreement, hospital data governance
template_mechanism: CONTRIBUTING + repo roles + release-checklist (platform part); IRB/DUA external
